title: 12 · API client + TanStack Query hooks
description:
## Objective
One typed module is the single source of truth for talking to the API; TanStack Query hooks wrap it
so components get loading/error/cache and never call fetch directly.

## Depends on
Task 10 (web scaffold), Task 08 (bookings API), Task 09 (shared types.ts).

## In scope (packages/web/src/api)
- client.ts: `request<T>(method, path, body?)` using fetch + VITE_API_BASE_URL; parse JSON; throw a
  typed `ApiError {code,message,status}` decoding the `{error:{code,message}}` envelope on non-2xx.
- packages.ts: listPackages(params), getPackage(id), createPackage, updatePackage, deletePackage.
- bookings.ts: createBooking, listBookings(status?), getBookingByCode, confirmBooking.
- hooks.ts: usePackages(params), usePackage(id), useBookingByCode, useBookings(status); mutations
  useCreateBooking, useConfirmBooking, useCreate/Update/DeletePackage with stable query keys
  (['packages',params], ['package',id], ['bookings',status], ['booking',code]) and invalidateQueries.
- QueryClientProvider in main.tsx. errors.ts: map codes (validation_error/not_found/conflict) → Spanish.

## Acceptance criteria
- usePackages() returns seeded data from the live API; loading/error surface.
- Mutations invalidate + refetch correctly.
- Non-2xx throws ApiError carrying envelope code/message.
- No component imports fetch directly; typecheck passes against the generated types.

title: 07 · Packages API endpoints
description:
## Objective
Expose the package resource over HTTP (public list/detail + agent create/update/delete) backed by
the repository.

- Invalid destination → 400 envelope; unknown id → 404.

title: 08 · Bookings API endpoints
description:
## Objective
Expose the booking resource. The server is authoritative: it generates the code, computes the
total, and sets status. New bookings are always Pendiente.

## Depends on
Task 06 (Axum skeleton).

## Endpoints (under /api)
- `POST /api/bookings` {NewBooking: packageId, departureDate, people, contact} → look up package
  (404 if missing) + matching departure by date (400 if not offered); validate (people 1..12,
  contact valid); total = departurePrice × people (IGNORE any client total); code = CB-XXXX;
  status Pendiente; created_at now → 201 Booking. On rare code collision (unique index) regenerate.
- `GET /api/bookings?status=Pendiente|Confirmada` → 200 Booking[] (pending-first, then newest).
- `GET /api/bookings/:code` → 200 Booking | 404 (confirmation lookup by human code).
- `POST /api/bookings/:id/confirm` → Pendiente→Confirmada → 200 Booking | 404 | 409 (already
  confirmed; message the UI can show, e.g. "La reserva ya estaba confirmada").

## Out of scope
Real payments, notifications, cancellation/refunds.

## Acceptance criteria
- Total computed server-side; client total ignored.
- Date not offered → 400; unknown package → 404.
- Response has a unique CB-XXXX code and status Pendiente.
- List pending-first + status filter; get-by-code works; confirm flips status; second confirm → 409.
close_reason: Completed and verified live via curl against seeded Mongo

title: 01 · Monorepo scaffolding (workspace + tooling)
description:
## Objective
Stand up a dual-language monorepo (Rust + TypeScript/React) so both sides build, format, and lint
with one consistent tooling story. Builds empty but green.

## Stack & layout (target)
- Rust crates as a Cargo workspace under `crates/`; JS/TS packages under `packages/`.
- App stack: React + Vite + TypeScript frontend; Rust + Axum backend; MongoDB; Tauri 2 for Android.
```
Cargo.toml (workspace members=["crates/*"])   rust-toolchain.toml
package.json + pnpm-workspace.yaml (packages:["packages/*"])   biome.json
docker-compose.yml   justfile   .env.example   .gitignore
crates/caribe-core/ (lib)   crates/caribe-api/ (bin)   packages/web/ (later)
```

## In scope
- Root Cargo workspace: `resolver=2`, `[workspace.package]` (edition, version 0.1.0, license),
  `[workspace.dependencies]` pinning shared crates (serde, serde_json, tokio, axum, mongodb,
  anyhow, thiserror, tracing, tracing-subscriber, chrono, uuid, tower-http) so members use
  `{ workspace = true }`.
- Placeholder crates `crates/caribe-core` (lib.rs stub) and `crates/caribe-api` (main.rs stub) that
  compile.
- `rust-toolchain.toml` (stable + rustfmt, clippy).
- Root pnpm workspace (`package.json` private, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`).
- `biome.json` (format+lint TS/JS: 2-space, single quotes, organize imports).
- `.gitignore` (target/, node_modules/, dist/, .env), `.env.example`
  (`MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017`, `MONGODB_DB=caribe_trips`, `API_BIND=0.0.0.0:8080`,
  `WEB_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173`).
- `justfile` recipes: fmt, lint, check, build, dev, up, down.

## Out of scope
Business logic, Axum server body, React app body, docker-compose contents, Tauri crate.

## Acceptance criteria
- `cargo check` + `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean at root.
- `cargo fmt --check` clean.
- `pnpm install` resolves; `biome check .` runs.
- `just check` runs both toolchains green.

title: 04 · MongoDB repository layer
description:
## Objective
Wrap MongoDB behind a small repository API so nothing else touches the driver. Connection,
collections, CRUD for packages/bookings, indexes.

## Depends on
Task 03 (domain models), Task 02 (MongoDB running).

## In scope (crates/caribe-core/src/repo)
- `Db::connect(uri, db_name) -> Result<Db>` (holds mongodb::Database; ping on connect).
- `ensure_indexes()`: index `packages.destination`, `packages.featured`, `bookings.status`;
  UNIQUE index `bookings.code`.
- `PackageRepo`: list(filter), get(id), create(NewPackage), update(id,UpdatePackage), delete(id).
  `PackageFilter { destination: Option<Destination>, q: Option<String> }` (q → case-insensitive
  regex on title + short_pitch). Compute `price_from` on create/update.
- `BookingRepo`: create(Booking), list(status: Option<BookingStatus>) (pending-first), get_by_code,
  confirm(id) (Pendiente→Confirmada; error if already confirmed), get(id).
- `_id` is Mongo ObjectId; map to/from a hex `id: String` on domain models. Bad/unknown id →
  `RepoError::NotFound` (thiserror), never panic.
- tokio-based integration tests (gated by `MONGODB_TEST_URI`).

## Out of scope
Seeding, HTTP handlers.

## Acceptance criteria
- connect succeeds against compose Mongo; ensure_indexes idempotent.
- Package CRUD works; list filters by destination and by q (case-insensitive).
- Booking create persists; get_by_code finds it; confirm flips status and is not repeatable;
  unique index blocks duplicate codes.
- Repo methods return domain models, not BSON.
close_reason: Completed: Mongo repo layer; integration tests pass against real Mongo; clippy/fmt clean

- Enums: `Destination` = PuntaCana | Samana | Bayahibe | LaRomana (serde renamed to those strings);

MongoDB I/O, HTTP, TS type generation.

- Types round-trip to/from the camelCase JSON.
- `generate_booking_code` is `CB-XXXX`, no ambiguous chars, stable across 10k runs.
- Validation rejects people 0/>12, empty name, malformed email, departure not in package.
